design: Locked 2023 model specifications; training requires both actual interview years2023, test requires both years2024; later records in older release are excluded before fitting
estimand: Equal-person error conditional on observed eligible linked respondents; not national population inference
interval_scope: Descriptive observed-test-PSU resampling within released strata, fixed 2023 training and predictions; excludes training/refitting and joint-population weighting uncertainty
